title: How Much of SAR Vehicle Recognition Is the Vehicle? Background Shortcuts, Angle Gaps and Partial Libraries on MSTAR and ATRNet-STAR
abstract: arXiv:2611.21827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep networks score near 99% on the MSTAR vehicle benchmark, and the newer ATRNet-STAR benchmark was built to be harder. We ask how much of these scores comes from the vehicle itself. With a modern network (ConvNeXt-Small, 3 seeds) we first reproduce the known MSTAR result: with the central 96x96 pixels zeroed out, accuracy is still 73.3% (chance 10%). The same shortcut is present in ATRNet-STAR, which was collected across several scenes: with the vehicle removed, accuracy is 63.3% on the 40-class SOC split (chance 2.5%). Under the official scene-change split, the background stops helping and starts hurting. Accuracy is 22.8% on full chips and 30.8% when only the vehicle is shown. A SAR foundation model, SARATR-X, leans on the background more than ConvNeXt does (+4 to +6 points with the vehicle removed, in every seed) and does not solve the scene change. translated_title: SAR车辆识别中有多少功劳属于车辆本身？——MSTAR与ATRNet-STAR上的背景捷径、俯仰角差异与部分库问题
translated_abstract: 深度网络在MSTAR车辆基准上的得分接近99%，而较新的ATRNet-STAR基准被构建得更具挑战性。我们探究这些得分中有多少来自车辆本身。使用现代网络（ConvNeXt-Small，3个随机种子），我们首先复现了已知的MSTAR结果：在将中心96×96像素置零后，准确率仍达73.3%（随机水平为10%）。同样的捷径也存在于跨多个场景采集的ATRNet-STAR中：移除车辆后，在40类SOC划分上准确率为63.3%（随机水平为2.5%）。在官方的场景变化划分下，背景不再有益，反而开始有害：完整切片的准确率为22.8%，而仅显示车辆时为30.8%。SAR基础模型SARATR-X比ConvNeXt更依赖背景（移除车辆后每个种子均高出4到6个百分点），且无法解决场景变化问题。随后，我们在固定训练数据量的情况下改变所使用的俯仰角……
tldr: 研究发现SAR车辆识别模型的高准确率很大程度上来自背景捷径而非车辆本身，并系统量化了背景捷径、俯仰角差异与部分训练库在MSTAR和ATRNet-STAR基准上的影响。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that high SAR vehicle recognition accuracy largely stems from background shortcuts rather than the vehicles themselves, systematically quantifying the effects of background shortcuts, depression angle gaps, and partial libraries on the MSTAR and ATRNet-STAR benchmarks.
